ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; approximately 55% low-intensity (black) to 45% high-intensity (white/cream) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe: Primary high-intensity white field with multiple discrete, circular low-intensity black spots (focal blobs) distributed mid-surface. Right lobe: Primary low-intensity black field with high-intensity white linear streaks and a focal yellowish-cream patch located near the proximal-medial boundary.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serrated boundary with peak-to-valley pixel amplitudes of approximately 10-25 pixels, forming a jagged, non-linear edge across both visible lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Distinct convex curvature observed from the water-line toward the distal tips on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast white circular clusters (barnacle colonies) localized specifically on the extreme distal tips of both the left and right fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A prominent, unaligned dark linear disruption (rake mark) approximately 100-150 pixels in length, oriented diagonally across the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on distal lobe tips and multiple parallel rake marks on the right ventral lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct yellowish-tan pigment variation patch located on the lower-middle portion of the right lobe surface.
